subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.9 QQBot: long markdown reply is split into N independent bubbles (one per chunk), not a single message

question: Should QQBot keep proactive multi-message Markdown splitting as the supported behavior, or merge safe-size chunks into one visible QQ bubble as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99032 proposes?
rationale: Current source still implements the reported split, a recent MEMBER comment says that split is by design, and the open fix PR has proof for the opposite UX direction but is not merged.

options.title: Confirm proactive splitting
options.body: Treat current splitting as the QQBot contract, document the per-message limit/truncation reason, and close the linked fix PR as not planned.

options.title: Adopt safe-size merging
options.body: Refresh and review the linked PR, require the existing 3600-byte guard plus fallback behavior, and close this issue only after merge.

recommendation.title: Confirm proactive splitting
recommendation.body: Treat current splitting as the QQBot contract, document the per-message limit/truncation reason, and close the linked fix PR as not planned.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp both authored the current QQBot Markdown chunking behavior and provided the latest maintainer-side design rationale on this issue.
